violations.why: req6_isr (priority 3) can preempt req1_isr (priority 2) between its write of irq and the check, so irq can be -1.
Higher-priority req5, req7 or req8 can write irq=0 between req6's write and its check.
req3_isr (priority 3) can preempt req1's JudgeCondi between the two reads and change the value.
req3_isr can write between the two reads in req1's JudgeCondi.
Higher-priority req5, req7 or req8 can run init and overwrite global_id between req3's exit write and its check.
req3_isr can preempt req1 between its init and exit writes and see a transient global_id.
req8_isr (priority 6) can preempt req7_isr between its write to array[9000] and the read, changing the value.
